patterns.note: A full-bleed, dense masonry grid is used on the homepage to showcase a large volume of diverse portfolio work, contrasting with more structured, sectioned layouts on interior pages.
Headings frequently combine a large, bold, modern sans-serif with an elegant, contrasting serif font for specific words, creating a sophisticated typographic interplay.
A high-contrast dark mode palette (black background, white text) is consistently applied, allowing vibrant, full-bleed imagery to serve as the primary source of color and visual interest.

The site features a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the main content scrolls. The initial large hero text scrolls off-screen to reveal a dense, masonry-style grid of project thumbnails.

technique_notes: The header is fixed to the top of the viewport, providing persistent navigation. The initial hero content is designed to scroll away, smoothly transitioning to the main content area which is a dynamic, masonry-style grid of images that fills the available space as it comes into view.
The design utilizes a dark background with stark white typography for high contrast, punctuated by full-bleed, high-quality photographic and design work that introduces color and visual interest.
Typography employs a large, bold sans-serif for primary headings, often paired with a contrasting elegant serif font for emphasis within the same heading or for specific callouts.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif hero text (~4-5x body) with a contrasting elegant serif for specific words, and a clear hierarchy for subheadings and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most elements, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy for the initial hero section, transitioning to a dense, packed grid for the portfolio, and balanced spacing on interior content pages.

standout: The striking contrast between the minimalist, dark interface and the rich, diverse, full-bleed imagery creates a sophisticated visual experience. The unique typographic pairing of a bold sans-serif with an elegant serif within headings is also highly distinctive.
